definitions.explanation: The first meal of the day, eaten in the morning. More formal than {朝|あさ}ごはん.

examples.japanese: {朝食|ちょうしょく}は{何時|なんじ}からですか。
{朝食|ちょうしょく}を{取|と}る{時間|じかん}がなかった。
examples.english: I didn't have time to have breakfast.

examples.japanese: {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}きのプランを{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: I booked a plan that includes breakfast.

examples.japanese: {朝食|ちょうしょく}を{抜|ぬ}くと{体|からだ}に{良|よ}くない。
examples.english: Skipping breakfast is not good for your health.

examples.japanese: このホテルの{朝食|ちょうしょく}バイキングは{種類|しゅるい}が{豊富|ほうふ}で{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: This hotel's breakfast buffet is popular because of its wide variety.

notes:
REGISTER: More formal than {朝|あさ}ごはん. Often used in business contexts, hotels, and written language.

MEAL NAMES:
- {朝食|ちょうしょく} / {朝|あさ}ごはん (breakfast)
- {昼食|ちゅうしょく} / {昼|ひる}ごはん (lunch)
- {夕食|ゆうしょく} / {晩|ばん}ごはん (dinner)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}を{取|と}る/を{食|た}べる (eat breakfast)
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}{付|つ}き (with breakfast included)
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}バイキング (breakfast buffet)
- {朝食|ちょうしょく}{抜|ぬ}き (skipping breakfast)
